            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-mobile (all/none)' \
            -f android_content=all -f android_track=beta -f ios_content=none \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  cli:
    name: 'Leg: CLI + macOS desktop'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 335m (version 20 + build-macos 150×2 — the
    # arm64 AND x86_64 matrix legs SERIALIZE on the single self-hosted
    # macOS runner — + release-macos 15); 360m leg ≥ worst-case + margin
    # (both build-macos jobs carry 150m server-side timeouts, #344). A
    # queued child — including one waiting out a sibling's full 150m
    # matrix leg — is NEVER cancelled (gh-1903); the leg timeout bounds
    # the wait and the watcher orphan-cancels only a never-started child.
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'cli')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'cli'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=cli) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      - name: Dispatch build-macos.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Children derive version themselves (latest tag + 1 at their own
          # dispatch moment) — a tag pinned here would race auto_release and
          # could attach assets to a tag pointing at a different commit.
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903 read-only wait; correlation from #343):
          # correlates OUR run by the child's run-name
          # ("build-macos (create_release=true)") so a concurrent human
          # dispatch is never adopted. A wedged self-hosted run is NEVER
          # cancelled/re-dispatched — the bounds are the build-macos jobs'
          # own 150m server-side timeouts (#344) and this leg's 360m; on
          # leg timeout the watcher orphan-cancels only this leg's own
          # never-started child.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-macos.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-macos (create_release=true)' \
            -f create_release=true \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  windows:
    name: 'Leg: Windows app'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 85m (version 20 + windows build 45 +
    # attach 20); 150m leg > worst-case + margin (the addin-leg sizing).
    timeout-minutes: 150
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'windows')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'windows'
        run: |
          exit 1

      - name: Dispatch build-windows.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The child derives the version itself (same latest-tag+1 math as
          # build-macos/build-mobile — all release children derive the SAME
          # next tag). Shared watcher (gh-1903): correlates OUR run by the
          # child's run-name, waits READ-ONLY within the child's own
          # timeout bounds, orphan-cancels only this leg's never-started
          # child on leg timeout.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-windows.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-windows (create_release=true)' \
            -f create_release=true \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  website:
    name: 'Leg: Website'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 60m (pages build 45 + deploy 15); 180m leg
    # ≫ worst-case + margin. (The old 45m leg pre-dated #351 and could not
    # even fit a healthy child + appear window — the 180m leg is the
    # #351 sizing.)
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'website')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'website'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=website) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      # pages.yml is path-filtered on push, so routine pushes (e.g. lib/
      # changes outside its filters) never redeploy — the daily guarantees
      # fa1.dev tracks main.
      - name: Dispatch pages.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903 read-only wait; correlation from #343).
          # pages.yml takes no inputs, so there is no displayTitle to
          # disambiguate on — the watcher falls back to
          # newest-in-tight-window and waits read-only: no cancel, no
          # re-dispatch, bounded by the pages jobs' own timeout-minutes
          # (#344) and this leg's 180m.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh pages.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  addin:
    name: 'Leg: Outlook add-in'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 45m (single office-addin-suite job); 150m
    # leg ≫ worst-case + margin. (The old 45m leg pre-dated #351 and could
    # not even fit a healthy child + appear window — 150m is the #351
    # sizing.)
    timeout-minutes: 150
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'addin')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'addin'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=addin) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      # Acceptance suite (manifest validation, dart2js taskpane, Node +
      # Playwright e2e). The fa1.dev /outlook publish itself rides the
      # website leg — pages.yml assembles the same add-in into the deploy.
      - name: Dispatch office-addin.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (gh-1903 read-only wait; correlation from #343).
          # No inputs to disambiguate on (newest-in-tight-window
          # fallback); the wait is bounded by the office-addin-suite
          # job's own 45m timeout (#344) and this leg's 150m — never by a
          # watcher cancel.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh office-addin.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  # ── pub.dev leg ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # The ONLY publish path is the ci.yml tag job (pub.dev trusted publishing
  # only accepts OIDC from tag-push runs — a schedule/dispatch run can never
  # satisfy it). This leg VERIFIES pub.dev serves the pubspec version and,
  # when behind, recovers by re-running the failed tag-push publish run —
  # a rerun keeps the original push-tag event and OIDC claims, so the real
  # publish path retries. Unrecoverable states fail loudly and self-file an
  # issue with a manual-publish instruction instead of silently hanging.
  # gh-1192: a tag-publish still EXECUTING (tag pushed, ci run not visible
  # yet or queued/in_progress, tag younger than the grace window) is
  # classified «release in flight» by scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh —
  # a neutral skip (no error, no auto-filed issue); the next scheduled
  # daily re-verifies. The 2026-10-03 collision fired the old «no ci.yml
  # run» error one minute before the healthy run completed (#1189, false
  # alarm). gh-1522: the version under test is the LATEST REMOTE TAG (the
  # committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder), so the «tag not cut
  # yet» state no longer exists.

  pubdev:
    name: 'Leg: pub.dev'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write # gh run rerun of the tag-publish run
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'pubdev')
    outputs:
      status: ${{ steps.check.outputs.status }}
      pubspec_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.pubspec }}
      published_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.published }}
      run_url: ${{ steps.check.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'pubdev'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=pubdev) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing published"
          exit 1

      # gh-1561: the never-triggered self-heal re-pushes the latest tag with
      # the fa-release-bot App token — a GITHUB_TOKEN push can never cascade
      # (gh-1172), the App's push can (the same mechanism ci.yml's release
      # job uses to cut tags). Job-scoped, expires with the job; this job's
      # own GITHUB_TOKEN stays read-scoped (job-level permissions block).
      # Shape mirrors the validator-proven precedent (ci.yml release job,
      # the create-github-app-token step): NO `if:` at all — secrets
      # context in a step-if trips GitHub's workflow validator; and a mint
      # on an unconfigured App (forks, rotation gap) fails, is SWALLOWED by
      # continue-on-error, outputs.token stays empty, and the script's
      # manual-re-push alarm fires exactly as before this change.
      # Least privilege, verified against the PINNED action (v3.2.0,
      # bcd2ba49 — review thread 10): the composite `permissions` input
      # does NOT exist there (action.yml defines only the generated
      # `permission-*` inputs — GitHub warns `Unexpected input(s)
      # 'permissions'` and the action never reads it; ci.yml:3980 rides
      # that warning). The HONORED ceiling is the granular
      # `permission-contents` input, which the action turns into the mint
      # request's permissions map: contents:write only — the tag re-push —
      # instead of the installation's full grant set. Without it the token
      # inherits every permission the fa-release-bot installation has.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@f418cff399f7aef4c2f0ad47e25ca7a6abbdd6fc # v3.4.0
        id: app-token
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permission-contents: write

      - name: Verify pub.dev serves the pubspec version
        id: check
        # gh-1192: the classification (up-to-date / release-in-flight /
        # recovered + the unchanged alarms) lives in the extracted script so
        # it is shell-harness testable (test/release_flow_race_test.dart).
        # RELEASE_APP_TOKEN is empty when the mint above skipped (App not
        # configured) — the script then fails over to the manual-re-push
        # alarm instead of attempting a re-arm.
        env:
          RELEASE_APP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: bash scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh

  # ── Release-draft sweeper (issue #282) ────────────────────────────────────
  # Hygiene leg: no pipeline step may leave a draft release behind (the
  # 3-week-old v0.1.190 rot). The per-job guards in build-macos/build-mobile
  # own the failure path; this sweeper is the daily backstop — anything that
  # slips through (a cancelled run, a path without a guard) is deleted after
  # 24h and a deduplicated self-closing issue names the creating run so a
  # RECURRING stuck draft points at its broken step instead of rotting.
  # Exception (gh-236): the machine loop's artefact-cache drafts
  # (ai-gh-*/ai-pr-* — per-ticket session-snapshot storage) are
  # lifecycle-managed, not findings: reclaimed the moment their ticket
  # closes, swept after 24h while parked, kept while in flight — so the
  # sweep issue auto-closes when only cache traffic remains.
  # Runs on every daily (and manual) invocation regardless of leg results —
  # change-gating must not gate hygiene.
  sweep-drafts:
    name: Sweep stale release drafts
    needs: plan
    if: always() # even when plan failed or all legs skipped
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write # delete draft releases
      actions: read # name each swept draft's creating run (gh run list 403s without it, review of #294)
      issues: write # deduplicated self-closing sweep issue
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      # gh-2287: the machine-account identity — drafts authored by it are
      # pipeline-created (stale ones swept), not human (kept, E1). Same
      # env var + default as daily_publish_report.sh; the script works
      # without it, the export keeps the wiring reviewable.
      DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE: ai-teammate
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Delete drafts older than 24h and file the dedup issue
        run: bash scripts/sweep_stale_drafts.sh

  # ── Report + self-healing issues ─────────────────────────────────────────
  report:
    name: Summary + self-filed issues
    needs: [plan, testflight, play, pubdev, cli, website, addin]
    if: always() # runs even when plan failed, so plan failures enter the self-healing loop too
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      issues: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Job summary table and issue lifecycle
        env:
          NEXT_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.next_tag }}
          PLAN_RESULT: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE: ai-teammate
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT: ${{ needs.testflight.result }}
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT_URL: ${{ needs.testflight.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PLAY: ${{ needs.play.result }}
          LEG_PLAY_URL: ${{ needs.play.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PUBDEV: ${{ needs.pubdev.result }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_STATUS: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.status }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBSPEC: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.pubspec_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBLISHED: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.published_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_URL: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_CLI: ${{ needs.cli.result }}
          LEG_CLI_URL: ${{ needs.cli.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_WEBSITE: ${{ needs.website.result }}
          LEG_WEBSITE_URL: ${{ needs.website.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_ADDIN: ${{ needs.addin.result }}
          LEG_ADDIN_URL: ${{ needs.addin.outputs.run_url }}
        run: bash scripts/daily_publish_report.sh

      # gh-1478: the inject_failure TEST hook must prove the filed digest
      # QUOTES the injected ::error:: line (signal-first excerpt via the
      # per-job log endpoint), not merely that an issue exists — the #1473
      # tree-noise regression class.
      # The `!= ''` guard matters: on schedule triggers the `inputs` context
      # is EMPTY (the dispatch `default: none` does not apply), so gating
      # only on `!= 'none'` would run — and fail — this step every cron run.
      - name: Verify injected-failure excerpt (TEST)
        if: always() && inputs.inject_failure != '' && inputs.inject_failure != 'none'
        env:
          INJECTED: ${{ inputs.inject_failure }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          title="[daily-publish] ${INJECTED} leg failed"
          n=$(gh issue list --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --state open \
                --label daily-publish --limit 200 \
                --json number,title --jq '.[] | [.number, .title] | @tsv' \
                | while IFS=$'\t' read -r num t; do
                    [ "$t" = "$title" ] && echo "$num"
                  done | head -1)
          if [ -z "$n" ]; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: no open issue titled '${title}' — the self-filing path regressed"
            exit 1
          fi
          text=$(gh issue view "$n" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
                   --json body,comments --jq '.body, (.comments[]?.body // empty)')
          if ! grep -qF "injected failure (inject_failure=${INJECTED})" <<< "$text"; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: issue #${n} never quotes the injected ::error:: line — the signal-first excerpt regressed (gh-1478)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "inject_failure verify OK: issue #${n} quotes the injected error line (gh-1478)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# update_git_mirror.sh — resilient local git-mirror update (gh-1644).
#
# Replaces the single-shot inline logic in build-macos.yml / build-mobile.yml
# ("Update local git mirror(s)" steps). The old logic fetched ONCE with
# stderr swallowed (`2>/dev/null`), and on any failure fell through to a
# FULL `git clone --mirror` whose ~1 h transfer died mid-flight on the
# self-hosted runner's flaky link (run 38855793382:
# "error: 2931 bytes of body are still expected", exit 128) — no retry,
# and a killed clone left a partial mirror dir behind.
#
# Contract (asserted by scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh):
#   - fetch retries MIRROR_FETCH_ATTEMPTS times (default 3) with
#     MIRROR_RETRY_SLEEP seconds (default 10) between attempts, stderr
#     visible — the first-failure cause is no longer swallowed;
#   - each attempt aborts on a stalled connection (<1 KB/s for 60 s) so a
#     wedged transfer engages the bounded retries instead of holding the
#     step for an hour;
#   - persistent fetch failure → recreate. The clone lands in a SIBLING
#     dir ("$mirror.recreate") and is swapped in ONLY on success — a
#     recreate whose every attempt dies mid-transfer leaves the last
#     good (stale-but-valid) mirror in place instead of nothing at all
#     (gh-1665 review thread 3; the dependent checkouts pull tip blobs
#     from origin anyway). The partial dir is removed before EVERY
#     attempt (a killed clone leaves a non-repo dir that would fail the
#     next attempt with "already exists"), and the recreation is a
#     BLOBLESS mirror (`--filter=blob:none` — the gh-1477
#     precedent in this repo): commits/trees only, ~90% less transfer,
#     shrinking the recreate window from ~1 h to minutes. The dependent
#     checkouts use `git clone --reference <mirror> --depth=1` and pull
#     tip blobs from origin, so they never need historical blobs from the
#     mirror. An EXISTING full mirror is untouched — fetches stay cheap;
#     only recreations become blobless;
#   - recreation retries MIRROR_CLONE_ATTEMPTS times (default 3);
#   - every failure path exits nonzero with a ::error annotation and
#     leaves NO partial clone dir behind ("$mirror.recreate" is always
#     cleaned up); the previous mirror survives a failed recreate.
#
# Usage: update_git_mirror.sh <url> <mirror-path>
# Run from anywhere:  bash scripts/update_git_mirror.sh URL MIRROR
set -euo pipefail

url="${1:?usage: update_git_mirror.sh <url> <mirror-path>}"
mirror="${2:?usage: update_git_mirror.sh <url> <mirror-path>}"

fetch_attempts="${MIRROR_FETCH_ATTEMPTS:-3}"
clone_attempts="${MIRROR_CLONE_ATTEMPTS:-3}"
retry_sleep="${MIRROR_RETRY_SLEEP:-10}"

# Stall guard for http(s) remotes (no-op for file/local remotes): an
# attempt moving <1 KB/s for 60 s is dead — retry instead of hanging.
# The run-38855793382 death was a 62-minute transfer ending in
# "2931 bytes of body are still expected".
STALL_GUARD=(-c http.lowSpeedLimit=1000 -c http.lowSpeedTime=60)

is_repo() { git -C "$1" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; }

recreate_mirror() {
  # Clone into a sibling and swap on success: a failed recreate must not
  # destroy the last good mirror (gh-1665 review thread 3).
  local attempt tmp="$mirror.recreate"
  for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= clone_attempts; attempt++)); do
    echo "recreate attempt ${attempt}/${clone_attempts}: $mirror"
    rm -rf "$tmp"
    if git "${STALL_GUARD[@]}" clone --mirror --filter=blob:none "$url" "$tmp"; then
      rm -rf "$mirror"
      mv "$tmp" "$mirror"
      echo "mirror recreated: $mirror (blobless)"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "git clone --mirror failed (attempt ${attempt}/${clone_attempts})" >&2
    if [ "$attempt" -lt "$clone_attempts" ]; then
      sleep "$retry_sleep"
    fi
  done
  rm -rf "$tmp"   # never leave a partial clone behind
  echo "::error::update_git_mirror: recreating $mirror from $url failed after ${clone_attempts} attempt(s) — last good mirror preserved" >&2
  return 1
}

if [ -d "$mirror" ] && is_repo "$mirror"; then
  for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= fetch_attempts; attempt++)); do
    echo "fetch attempt ${attempt}/${fetch_attempts}: $mirror"
    if git -C "$mirror" "${STALL_GUARD[@]}" fetch origin; then
      echo "mirror updated: $mirror"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "git fetch failed (attempt ${attempt}/${fetch_attempts})" >&2
    if [ "$attempt" -lt "$fetch_attempts" ]; then
      sleep "$retry_sleep"
    fi
  done
  echo "git fetch failed after ${fetch_attempts} attempt(s) — recreating the mirror" >&2
fi

recreate_mirror

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Release-notes generator (issue #282): useful, mechanical notes for every
# release path — no more "Release v$next" filler bodies.
#
# Usage: release_notes.sh <version> [range_start]
#   version     bare X.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z
#   range_start optional git ref for the fallback range (default: the
#               newest tag other than vX.Y.Z itself)
#
# Order of preference:
#   1. the CHANGELOG.md `## <version>` section (curated per-release notes);
#   1b. (gh-1522) the curated `## Unreleased` body — the release flow moves
#      Unreleased into the tag's section AT STAGE TIME (never in-repo), so
#      a pending Unreleased section IS this release's notes when no
#      versioned section exists yet;
#   2. conventional commits since the previous tag, grouped
#      Features / Fixes / Maintenance, capped at 50 lines with an
#      "…and N more" line (issue #282 E4);
#   3. no commits since the previous tag (re-tag) -> a clean
#      "No changes" body, never an empty page (issue #282 E5/AC5).
set -euo pipefail

version="${1:?usage: release_notes.sh <version> [range_start]}"
version="${version#v}"
range_start="${2:-}"

# ── 1. CHANGELOG.md section for the version ────────────────────────────────
if [ -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then
  # gh-1522 rework (PR #1526): more than one `## Unreleased` header is a
  # merge/bot artifact duplicating the curation window — the preference-1b
  # awk below stops at the FIRST header, so the second section's entries
  # would silently never ship. Fail loud instead of publishing notes that
  # dropped content (pinned by the AC5 duplicate-Unreleased test).
  unreleased_count=$(grep -c '^## Unreleased[ \t]*$' CHANGELOG.md || true)
  if [ "$unreleased_count" -gt 1 ]; then
    echo "::error::CHANGELOG.md carries $unreleased_count '## Unreleased' sections — entries past the first silently never ship; keep exactly one (gh-1522 curation convention)" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  section=$(awk -v ver="$version" '
    BEGIN { esc = ver; gsub(/\./, "\\.", esc) }
    $0 ~ "^## " esc "[[:space:]]*$" { found = 1; next }
    found && /^## / { exit }
    found { print }
  ' CHANGELOG.md)
  if [ -n "$(printf '%s' "$section" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$section"
    exit 0
  fi
  # gh-1522 preference 1b: a pending curated `## Unreleased` section is
  # this release's notes (the stage-time stamper folds it under the tag's
  # generated section header).
  section=$(awk '
    /^## Unreleased[ \t]*$/ { found = 1; next }
    found && /^## / { exit }
    found { print }
  ' CHANGELOG.md)
  if [ -n "$(printf '%s' "$section" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$section"
    exit 0
  fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Lazy DRAFT create for the release train's asset-upload steps (gh-1801).
#
# The train workflows (ci.yml binaries/web-spa, build-macos.yml
# build-macos-cli/build-extension) need a release object to attach assets
# to, but the release must never go live from an upload step: `fa update`
# resolves the `latest` release and hard-fails without the SIGNED
# SHA256SUMS(.sig) (bin/self_manage.dart provenance gate), which only the
# tag-run release-provenance job can upload. This script creates the
# release as a DRAFT — nothing else:
#
#   - body = scripts/release_notes.sh output (curated `## <version>`
#     CHANGELOG section → curated `## Unreleased` → conventional commits;
#     the gh-1172 curated-notes contract), with a minimal fallback —
#     never `--generate-notes` (review threads 3/7);
#   - body carries `<!-- release-draft-owner: run/<run_id>/job/<job> -->`
#     so scripts/release_draft_guard.sh can reclaim the draft on failure
#     (review threads 4/8) — matrix legs override the identity via
#     RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY (e.g. binaries-linux-x64) so a failed leg's
#     guard can never match a sibling's in-flight draft;
#   - the view→create race is tolerated (`|| true`): a sibling leg or the
#     attach path may create the release between our view and create —
#     the loser just uploads into the winner's release;
#   - it NEVER publishes and NEVER flags latest: the single publish point
#     of a tag train is release-provenance's "Upload provenance assets"
#     step (`gh release edit --draft=false --latest` after SHA256SUMS.sig
#     lands). A red provenance leaves the previous release as latest —
#     safe degradation, never a provenance-less latest (v1.0.630 window).
#
# Usage: release_lazy_draft.sh <tag>
# Env: GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_JOB (Actions defaults),
#      RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY (optional leg-suffixed override),
#      GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN.
set -euo pipefail

tag="${1:?usage: release_lazy_draft.sh <tag>}"
repo="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:?GITHUB_REPOSITORY must be set}"
identity="${RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY:-run/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:?GITHUB_RUN_ID must be set (GitHub Actions default env)}/job/${GITHUB_JOB:?GITHUB_JOB must be set (GitHub Actions default env)}}"

# The guard greps exactly this class — validate here so a malformed
# override fails loud instead of stamping a marker the guard could never
# match (a forever-orphaned draft).
printf '%s' "$identity" | grep -Eq '^run/[0-9]+/job/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$' || {
  echo "::error::RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY '$identity' does not match 'run/<id>/job/<name>' — the draft lifecycle guard could never reclaim such a draft" >&2
  exit 1
}

# Already created (by a sibling leg, the attach path, or a previous run)?
# Drafts and published releases both resolve here — upload-only is safe.
if gh release view "$tag" --repo "$repo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

echo "$version" > build/out/bundle/version.txt

      - name: Ad-hoc sign CLI binary
        run: |
          codesign --force --sign - build/out/bundle/bin/fa

      # gh-2040: the native fa-clip pasteboard helper rides the macOS CLI
      # bundle (bundle/bin/fa-clip, per-arch — this matrix builds each arch
      # on a native runner, AC8) so install.sh / fa update ship it beside
      # the binary and image paste never rides Apple Events.
      - name: Build fa-clip pasteboard helper (gh-2040)
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.arch }}" = "x64" ]; then
            # gh-2408: /bin/bash (universal), never bare `bash` — on the
            # self-hosted macos-m5 pool PATH resolves `bash` to the
            # ARM-only Homebrew build and arch -x86_64 dies with
            # `posix_spawnp: bash: Bad CPU type in executable`.
            arch -x86_64 /bin/bash scripts/build_fa_clip.sh build/out/bundle/bin/fa-clip
          else
            bash scripts/build_fa_clip.sh build/out/bundle/bin/fa-clip
          fi
          codesign --force --sign - build/out/bundle/bin/fa-clip
          test -x build/out/bundle/bin/fa-clip

      - name: Archive and upload CLI bundle
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          # Matrix legs share GITHUB_JOB=build-macos-cli — the leg-suffixed
          # draft owner identity keeps the guard below scoped to the leg
          # that created the draft, never the sibling's mid-upload one.
          RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY: run/${{ github.run_id }}/job/${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-macos-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz"
          tar -czf "$asset" -C build/out bundle
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # gh-1801 (rework): DRAFT-first, publish is PROVENANCE-OWNED.
          # The CLI tarball is a `fa update` asset, but servability needs
          # the SIGNED SHA256SUMS — which only the tag-run's
          # release-provenance job uploads (ci.yml). So: create the draft
          # lazily (curated notes via release_notes.sh + THIS leg's
          # draft-owner marker the guard below can reclaim), upload, and
          # let provenance own the --draft=false --latest flip.
          bash scripts/release_lazy_draft.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"
          # gh-2042 AC1: the immutability gate owns the attach — a
          # PUBLISHED release (the same-tag convergence race) skips
          # attached assets and refuses unattached fa-* assets loud
          # instead of silently drifting the signed SHA256SUMS.
          bash scripts/release_asset_gate.sh "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      # Leg-scoped (gh-1801): matches only THIS arch leg's marker.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY: run/${{ github.run_id }}/job/${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'

# Root Cause Analysis — gh-2453 `[daily-publish] cli leg failed`

**Bug**: The daily-publish `cli` leg failed because the child run
`45945536578` job `Build macOS CLI arm64` (`build-macos-cli` matrix leg)
died at its 45-minute ceiling while stuck inside the checkout step.

**Root cause**: `.github/workflows/build-macos.yml`, job `build-macos-cli`
(lines ~1298–1312), checks out with a raw
`actions/checkout@3d3c42e5…` + `fetch-depth: 0` + `filter: blob:none`.
On the self-hosted `macos-m5` pool (one flaky-link Mac hosting the
fa-m5/fa-m5-2/fa-m5-3 registrations, gh-2013), that step runs an
un-guarded, un-retried full-history `git fetch --unshallow` against
github.com. In the failed run the workspace (fa-m5-3, previously an
`ai/gh-2426` agent tree) negotiated refs at 06:16:40, then the object
transfer stalled with zero output for **44m45s** — no stall guard, no
retry — until `timeout-minutes: 45` fired
("The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 45m0s") and the
cancellation failed the child run → the cli leg red → gh-2453 auto-filed.

This is the exact failure class the repo already fixed elsewhere:
gh-1644 (run 38855793382, "error: 2931 bytes of body are still expected"
after a 62-minute transfer) produced `scripts/update_git_mirror.sh`
(stall guard `http.lowSpeedLimit=100` / `http.lowSpeedTime=60`, bounded
retries, blobless recreation) plus mirror-seeded checkouts for the
`build-macos` desktop matrix and `build-mobile` iOS legs — but the
`build-macos-cli` job was left on the raw fragile path. Its sibling
`Build macOS CLI x64` ran the identical fetch in 2.25s that day (warm
workspace) — pure link roulette, gh-2072's "network roulette the release
train rides on every tag" class.

**Impact**: Any stall on the fa-m5 egress link during the CLI job's
checkout holds the job until the 45m ceiling, reding the daily-publish
`cli` leg (auto-filed issue). Non-deterministic: fires only when the
flaky link stalls. The rest of the run was healthy — the v1.0.786
release still shipped (arm64 CLI tarball missing from it), so the bug is
confined to this job's checkout resilience.

**Fix approach**: Move `build-macos-cli` onto the established mirror
pattern used by the `build-macos` desktop job on the same pool:
1. "Update local git mirrors" step (bootstrapped, stall-guarded,
   retried `scripts/update_git_mirror.sh` — unchanged).
2. Replace `actions/checkout` with a mirror-seeded checkout:
   `git clone --reference <mirror> --no-checkout --filter=blob:none`
   (blobless FULL history — preserves the gh-1801 contract that
   `release_lazy_draft.sh` → `release_notes.sh` reads commit messages
   since the previous tag; gh-1477 blobless precedent) wrapped in the
   same stall guard + bounded retries, then `git checkout --detach
   "$GITHUB_SHA"` (tip blobs via the promisor remote, guarded + retried).
   Network transfer drops from "all commits/trees of every ref + tip
   blobs, unguarded" to "tip blobs only, guarded, retried".

Preserved: job ceiling 45m (#351 budget arithmetic), `dart pub get` at
root + sqlite3 prewarm ordering (pinned by
`ci_sqlite3_prewarm_guard_test.dart` /
`ci_sqlite3_native_asset_seed_guard_test.dart`), draft-guard identity,
artifact/release attach flow.

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for this ticket.

**Verification**: new guard test
`test/ci_2453_macos_cli_mirror_checkout_guard_test.dart` pins the
contract (no raw checkout on the self-hosted CLI matrix, mirror
bootstrap, blobless full clone, stall guard, bounded retries, sha
checkout) — red before the fix, green after; sibling build-macos guard
tests + `scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh` re-run green.

arguments.newText:
steps:
      # ── Prepare persistent local git mirrors (gh-2453) ──────────────────────
      # The RAW actions/checkout this job used before (fetch-depth: 0 +
      # filter: blob:none) is banned on the fa-m5 pool: its un-guarded,
      # un-retried full-history `git fetch --unshallow` stalled for 44m45s
      # in run 45945536578 ("Build macOS CLI arm64") until the job's 45m
      # ceiling killed it — the sibling x64 leg ran the identical fetch in
      # 2.25s, pure link roulette (gh-2072's class). This is the gh-1644
      # failure class (run 38855793382, "error: 2931 bytes of body are
      # still expected"), already fixed for the build-macos desktop matrix
      # and the build-mobile iOS legs; build-macos-cli joins them with the
      # same bootstrapped script + stall guard + bounded retries. Contract:
      # scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh. Bootstrap (gh-1665): this
      # step runs BEFORE any checkout on persistent self-hosted runners —
      # the workspace may hold a pre-merge tree (or be wiped), so the
      # script is bootstrapped from the commit-pinned raw URL
      # (workflow_dispatch-only ⇒ ${{ github.sha }} is always a pushed
      # commit) with the mirror copy as the no-network fallback.
      - name: Update local git mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR_BASE="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror"
          mkdir -p "$MIRROR_BASE"
          MIRROR="$MIRROR_BASE/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          SCRIPT="$RUNNER_TEMP/update_git_mirror.sh"
          RAW="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/${{ github.sha }}/scripts/update_git_mirror.sh"
          if ! curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 "$RAW" -o "$SCRIPT" \
             || [ ! -s "$SCRIPT" ]; then
            echo "raw bootstrap failed — syncing the mirror and falling back to its copy" >&2
            if [ -d "$MIRROR" ] && git -C "$MIRROR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              git -C "$MIRROR" fetch origin || true
            else
              rm -rf "$MIRROR"
              git clone --mirror https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR" || true
            fi
            BRANCH="$(git --git-dir="$MIRROR" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)"
            git --git-dir="$MIRROR" show "$BRANCH:scripts/update_git_mirror.sh" > "$SCRIPT" \
              || { echo "::error::could not bootstrap update_git_mirror.sh (raw URL unreachable and mirror lacks the script)" >&2; exit 1; }
          fi
          bash "$SCRIPT" \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git \
            "$MIRROR"

      # ── Checkout from the local mirror (gh-2453) ────────────────────────────
      # gh-1644 stall-guarded + bounded-retried; gh-1600 workspace-tolerant
      # (the persistent shared workspace may hold a previous job's tree —
      # the fa-m5-3 workspace held an ai/gh-2426 agent checkout that
      # morning). BLOBLESS FULL — deliberately NOT the desktop matrix's
      # shallow clone: the lazy draft create (gh-1801 rework) builds the
      # release body via scripts/release_notes.sh, which falls back to
      # conventional commits since the previous tag (gh-1477: the notes
      # read commit MESSAGES, never historical file blobs —
      # --filter=blob:none keeps them out of the transfer, the mirror
      # supplies all commits/tags locally, so the network phase is the tip
      # blobs only). A stalled attempt aborts in ~60s
      # (http.lowSpeedLimit/http.lowSpeedTime — the update_git_mirror.sh
      # STALL_GUARD values) and engages the retries instead of holding the
      # step to the 45m ceiling. INLINE like the desktop checkout: local
      # `uses: ./...` actions resolve against $GITHUB_WORKSPACE at step
      # time — on this box that is the PREVIOUS run's tree, and this step
      # IS the checkout.
      - name: Checkout repository from local mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          MIRROR="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          URL="https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          echo "MIRROR=$MIRROR"
          echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          # gh-1600: tolerate stale unremovable paths in the persistent
          # shared workspace — log-and-prune, never fail the checkout.
          cd /tmp
          rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}"/stale-workspace-* 2>/dev/null || true
          if ! rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE not fully removable — stale paths held by another process (gh-1600); pruning what is removable"
            rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" || true
          fi
          if [ -d "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            STALE="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/stale-workspace-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
            echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE still non-empty after prune — moving the remainder to $STALE (gh-1600)"
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "$STALE")" 2>/dev/null || true
            if ! mv "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$STALE" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE could not be moved aside either — cloning around the stub (gh-1600)"
              rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" || true
            fi
          fi
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          CLONE_TARGET="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          if [ -n "$(ls -A "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            CLONE_TARGET="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE.checkout"
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
          fi

          # gh-1644 STALL_GUARD: an attempt moving <1 KB/s for 60s is a
          # dead connection — abort it and retry instead of hanging.
          GUARD=(-c http.lowSpeedLimit=1000 -c http.lowSpeedTime=60)

          rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
          clone_attempts=3
          clone_ok=0
          for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= clone_attempts; attempt++)); do
            echo "clone attempt ${attempt}/${clone_attempts}"
            if git "${GUARD[@]}" clone --no-checkout --filter=blob:none \
                 --reference "$MIRROR" "$URL" "$CLONE_TARGET"; then
              clone_ok=1
              break
            fi
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
            if [ "$attempt" -lt "$clone_attempts" ]; then sleep 10; fi
          done
          if [ "$clone_ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::mirror-seeded clone failed after ${clone_attempts} attempt(s) — mirror: $MIRROR (gh-2453)" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          # Materialize the working tree at the dispatched commit: the
          # blobless clone lazily fetches the tip blobs from origin (the
          # mirror carries commits/trees only, gh-1477 precedent). Guarded
          # + retried like the clone; already-fetched blobs persist across
          # attempts (promisor cache), so a retry resumes instead of
          # restarting the transfer.
          checkout_attempts=3
          checkout_ok=0
          for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= checkout_attempts; attempt++)); do
            echo "checkout attempt ${attempt}/${checkout_attempts}: $GITHUB_SHA"
            if git "${GUARD[@]}" -C "$CLONE_TARGET" checkout --detach "$GITHUB_SHA"; then
              checkout_ok=1
              break
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" -lt "$checkout_attempts" ]; then sleep 10; fi
          done
          if [ "$checkout_ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::checkout of $GITHUB_SHA failed after ${checkout_attempts} attempt(s) (gh-2453)" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$CLONE_TARGET" != "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ]; then
            while IFS= read -r entry; do
              name="$(basename "$entry")"
              if [ -e "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$name" ]; then
                echo "::warning::stub collision on '$name' — left in $CLONE_TARGET (gh-1600)"
              else
                mv "$entry" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/"
              fi
            done < <(find "$CLONE_TARGET" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
          fi

          echo "Checked out: $(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" log -1 --oneline)"
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

make_shim() {
  local dir="$1" fail_fetch="$2" fail_clone="$3"
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  echo "$fail_fetch" > "$dir/fetch_left"
  echo "$fail_clone" > "$dir/clone_left"
  cat > "$dir/git" <<SHIM
#!/usr/bin/env bash
REAL_GIT="$REAL_GIT"
LEFT="$(cd "$dir" && pwd)"
sub=""; skip=0
for a in "\$@"; do
  if [ "\$skip" = 1 ]; then skip=0; continue; fi
  case "\$a" in
    -c|-C) skip=1 ;;
    -*) ;;
    *) sub="\$a"; break ;;
  esac
done
case "\$sub" in
  fetch)
    if [ "\$(cat "\$LEFT/fetch_left")" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo \$(( \$(cat "\$LEFT/fetch_left") - 1 )) > "\$LEFT/fetch_left"
      echo "error: 2931 bytes of body are still expected" >&2
      echo "fetch-pack: unexpected disconnect while reading sideband packet" >&2
      exit 128
    fi ;;
  clone)
    if [ "\$(cat "\$LEFT/clone_left")" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo \$(( \$(cat "\$LEFT/clone_left") - 1 )) > "\$LEFT/clone_left"
      echo "error: 2931 bytes of body are still expected" >&2
      echo "fatal: early EOF" >&2
      exit 128
    fi ;;
esac
exec "\$REAL_GIT" "\$@"
SHIM
  chmod +x "$dir/git"
}

use_shim() {  # $1 = shim dir ("" = restore real git)
  if [ -n "$1" ]; then PATH="$1:$REAL_PATH"; else PATH="$REAL_PATH"; fi
}

extract_step_block() {
  awk -v want="$2" '
    index($0, "- name: " want) { iname = 1; next }
    iname && /^[ ]*- name:/   { iname = 0 }   # a different step came first
    iname && /^[ ]*run: \|/ {
      indent = match($0, /[^ ]/) - 1
      inblk = 1; iname = 0; next
    }
    inblk {
      if ($0 ~ /^[ ]*$/) { print ""; next }
      if (match($0, /[^ ]/) - 1 < indent) exit
      print substr($0, indent + 1)
    }
  ' "$1"
}

### Root Cause
The daily-publish `cli` leg failed in run 45945536578: job `Build macOS CLI arm64` sat 44m45s inside a raw `actions/checkout` (`fetch-depth: 0` + `filter: blob:none`) whose full-history `git fetch --unshallow` stalled silently on the flaky-link self-hosted fa-m5 pool — no stall guard, no retry — until the job's `timeout-minutes: 45` fired. The sibling `Build macOS CLI x64` ran the identical fetch in 2.25s: link roulette. This is the exact gh-1644 failure class (run 38855793382) that already produced `scripts/update_git_mirror.sh` + mirror checkouts for the desktop/iOS legs; `build-macos-cli` was simply left on the raw path.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/build-macos.yml` (`build-macos-cli`): replaced raw `actions/checkout` with the established mirror pattern — "Update local git mirrors" (bootstrapped, stall-guarded, retried `scripts/update_git_mirror.sh`) + "Checkout repository from local mirrors": `git clone --reference <mirror> --no-checkout --filter=blob:none` (blobless FULL history preserves the gh-1801 release-notes contract) under the gh-1644 stall guard (`http.lowSpeedLimit=100/lowSpeedTime=60`) with bounded retries, then a retried `git checkout --detach "$GITHUB_SHA"` for tip blobs. Network phase shrinks to tip-blobs-only, and a stalled attempt aborts in ~60s instead of holding the job to its ceiling.
- `scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh`: T10 drift-guard count 3 → 4 bootstrap sites (the new CLI site).
- `test/ci_2453_macos_cli_mirror_checkout_guard_test.dart` (new): 7 ACs pin the contract (no raw checkout on this pool, mirror bootstrap, blobless-full mirror-seded clone, stall guard, bounded retries + `::error`, detached `GITHUB_SHA`, step ordering).

### Test Coverage
- New guard test: red before the fix (0/7), green after (7/7) — `dart test test/ci_2453_macos_cli_mirror_checkout_guard_test.dart`.
- Sibling build-macos/release guard suites re-run green (315 tests, incl. keychain serialization, sqlite3 prewarm/seed, SPM lane, draft lifecycle, release hygiene).
- `scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh`: 13/13 (T10 updated for the 4th bootstrap site).
- E2E fixture simulation of the new checkout step (local origin + real mirror script): happy path, clone-fails-twice → recovers on attempt 3, always-fails → `::error` + nonzero exit, no partial dir.

### Notes
- Job ceiling stays 45m (#351 budget arithmetic unchanged); hosted-ubuntu jobs (`version`, `build-extension`, `release-macos`) keep raw checkout — the fix is scoped to the self-hosted macos-m5 pool.
- Concurrency with the sibling arch leg (parallel on one host, shared mirror) follows the existing desktop+iOS sharing precedent: `update_git_mirror.sh` retries absorb fetch lock contention.
- The step is intentionally inline like the desktop checkout (local `uses:` actions resolve against the pre-checkout workspace).

**Root cause** (recovered from the actual run logs via `gh`, since the ticket's failure excerpt was empty): in run 45945536578 the `Build macOS CLI arm64` job (`build-macos-cli` in `.github/workflows/build-macos.yml`) sat **44m45s** inside its raw `actions/checkout` (`fetch-depth: 0` + `filter: blob:none`), whose full-history `git fetch --unshallow` stalled silently on the self-hosted fa-m5 pool's flaky link — no stall guard, no retry — until the job's `timeout-minutes: 45` fired. The sibling `Build macOS CLI x64` ran the identical fetch in 2.25s: pure link roulette. This is the exact gh-1644 failure class (run 38855793382) that already produced `scripts/update_git_mirror.sh` + mirror-seeded checkouts for the desktop/iOS legs — `build-macos-cli` was left on the raw fragile path.
